# Bidwise

Bidwise helps students plan SMU BOSS bids. It shows past bid results by window and term, seat counts, and a forecast of the bid each section needs. It is free and independent, and not affiliated with SMU.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://bidwise.pages.dev/): course search
- [Browse](https://bidwise.pages.dev/explore/): past bids by window and term
- [Bid planner](https://bidwise.pages.dev/planner/): plan bids for several courses at once
- [Plan B](https://bidwise.pages.dev/plan-b/): other courses that count toward your degree requirements
- [Swap](https://bidwise.pages.dev/swap/): chances of swapping into another section
- [Schedule](https://bidwise.pages.dev/schedule/): bidding rounds and windows
- [How BOSS bidding works](https://bidwise.pages.dev/guide/): e$, rounds and windows, how the winning bid is decided, how to pick a bid
- [How the forecast works](https://bidwise.pages.dev/method/): method behind the forecast
- Course page: https://bidwise.pages.dev/course/<CODE>/ (forecast and sections), for example ACCT001
- Course history: https://bidwise.pages.dev/course/<CODE>/history/ (past clearing bids for every window and term)
